statement: At every odd prime, every Delta0-fixed element for an induced original packet on the stable S3 genus-two quotient has zero proper H1. On the stable S3 genus-three cover, the image of the fixed subgroup in open H1 is exactly the primitive selected boundary line. This includes all exceptional twists of A.24.
depends_on: A.25 stable reduction and monodromy witness; R1 and A.22 finite-index extension; A.4 reflection quotient representation; Betts-Dogra Theorem 3.1.6
notes: The tame monodromy is placed inside Delta0 by the local commutator [Frob,tame], with nonzero scalar q-1. All three reflection quotients jointly detect proper H1 of C3. Actual integral cusp powers remove the remaining boundary H1 class. Higher nonabelian fixed elements in the exceptional packets remain unresolved.
